finding: There was a significant increase in the CS rate during the COVID-19 pandemic compared to the previous year, primarily due to an increase in CS by maternal request.
mod_finding: The COVID-19 pandemic was associated with a significant increase in cesarean section rates, primarily due to an increase in maternal request.
cross-section timing: April to October 2019 (before the pandemic) and from March to September 2020 (during the pandemic)
